  "title": "Sky Steps Checkpoint Parkour",
  "summary": "Sky Steps is a focused, single-player floating obstacle course designed for crisp platforming on desktop and touch devices. Players spawn on a floating launch terrace overlooking a scenic cloudscape and immediately see a sequential chain of illuminated stepping pads, three ordered checkpoint pylons, a synchronized gliding platform crossing, an ethereal red void fall hazard, and a golden finish archway. Traversal enforces strict sequential progression (Checkpoint 1 -> Checkpoint 2 -> Checkpoint 3 -> Finish); early contact with downstream checkpoints is ignored until prior checkpoints are cleared. Activating each checkpoint triggers a radiant pulse animation, color transition, and audio chime. Falling into the hazard zone smoothly recovers the player at their last activated checkpoint with zero lost progress. A clean, responsive HUD displays the active checkpoint (e.g., 'Checkpoint 2 / 3') and live elapsed time down to tenths of a second. Crossing the finish arch stops the timer, plays a victory sound, and opens a completion panel with final time and a prominent Replay button that seamlessly resets course state and timer for another run.",
  "visualDirection": "Bright, high-contrast skyway aesthetic featuring clean floating platforms, soft cyan and gold energy accents, and crystal-clear depth readability. Stepping stones are distinct floating prisms with beveled edges and luminous neon trims to ensure reliable jump distance estimation on both small mobile screens and high-resolution desktop displays. Inactive checkpoints glow a dormant soft amber, transitioning to vibrant emerald cyan with particle chimes upon player activation. The moving platform is marked with directional chevron decals and glowing guides. The fall hazard below is a clearly readable crimson cloud plane. The HUD uses a modern, semi-transparent frosted card with bold typography and touch-friendly buttons.",
  "assetStrategy": "Query the Marketplace for reusable checkpoint pylons/pads and moving platform mechanisms that contain tested collision geometry, visual effects, and sound triggers. Inspect discovered models for embedded audio, tweens, and activation scripts, retaining useful visual/audio assets while integrating server-authoritative checkpoint sequence validation, fall recovery, and finish/replay synchronization. Marketplace audio will be discovered for checkpoint activation and course victory cues.",
